description: Copy paths and other items into another open document (onto its active layer or a named layer, at the same document coordinates), or onto the clipboard for pasting into other applications (Edit > Copy)

document.description: to: "document": the name of the open document to copy into (list_documents)

layer.description: to: "document": layer in that document. Default its active layer

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: copy_items
title: Copy Items
